messages:
marta: Heads-up — product wants a small, consistent surface for errors that the SDK can interpret. We need: canonical status taxonomy, telemetry fields for Console, and a clear SDK hint contract (retryable, user_actionable, degrade_grace). Who owns the canonical mapping?
kevin: eng-platform should own mapping + stable http -> semantic mapping. runtime can publish allowed runtime codes but platform owns client-facing contract.
nash: +1 to platform owning the contract. runtime team can add an RFC for any new internal errors but platform picks the exposed class.
nash: quick suggestion for a minimal set: `success`, `invalid_request`, `auth_error`, `quota_exceeded`, `rate_limited`, `server_error`, `model_unavailable`, `fallback_executed`.
sophie: Product: this must show up in Console UX as 1) top-level error category, 2) retry guidance, 3) whether it triggered a fallback. We also need dashboard filters by `error_category` and `fallback_used:true/false`.
travis: Console + telemetry note: add `telemetry.error_category`, `telemetry.retry_hint`, `telemetry.fallback_variant`. Those should be indexed by our metrics pipeline. Can we keep string enums to avoid mapping churn?
kevin: Agreed — enum strings only. Also require `http_status` numeric for backwards compatibility. New SDKs should prefer `error_category`.
nash: Example payload proposal (for runtime -> platform):
```json
{
  "http_status": 429,
  "error_category": "rate_limited",
  "message": "burst quota exceeded on route /v1/generate",
  "sdk_hint": "retryable:true;retry_after_ms=200",
  "fallback_used": "false"
}
```
marta: Love it, but make `sdk_hint` structured as short semicolon-separated tokens so older SDKs can parse easily. New SDKs will expose booleans.
travis: For Console tiles, we'll expose: count by `error_category`, p95 latency when `fallback_used=false`, and list of example messages (redact PII). I'll add a dashboard card draft.
sophie: Also need cohesive copy: engines should display human-friendly lines like: `Rate limit — try again after Xs` and an action link to quota console. We should provide copy templates per `error_category` in the contract.
kevin: Telemetry retention note: error categories should be exported to the incident datastore so alerts can be created on spikes. Add `error_category` to the default SLO/alert dimensions.
nash: Edge case: model fallback to smaller variant should surface as `model_unavailable` vs `fallback_executed`? I think `fallback_executed` should be a separate boolean and `error_category` should reflect the root cause (e.g., `model_unavailable`).
marta: Decision: error_category = root cause enum, fallback_used = boolean, fallback_variant = string optional. SDK will receive `retryable` boolean and `retry_after_ms` when present.
kevin: Backwards compatibility: if only `http_status` present, SDK maps 429 -> `rate_limited`, 503 -> `server_error`, 401/403 -> `auth_error`. We'll include mapping table in the contract doc.
travis: I'll sync Console copy with the mapping table. @marta can you own the contract doc and add a small JSON schema and example events?
marta: I will write the contract doc and open a PR against docs/references/errors.md by EOD tomorrow. I'll also add a tiny test harness for runtime to validate emitted fields.
dev-bot: CI: created issue INF-4823 "error-contract: schema + telemetry fields" and assigned to marta.
marta: Thanks — will link PR to INF-4823. Quick TODOs: marta: write contract; kevin: add mapping table to api-compat tests; travis: draft dashboard card; sophie: canonical UX copy snippets.
kevin: timeline — aim to land contract + tests next week. If anyone wants to block, speak now.
nash: No blockers on infra side.
sophie: Minor ask: product review before console copy goes live.
marta: Roger — I'll tag you.
